sections.text: The rearrangement promotes MYB activity through truncation of MYB, relocation of regulatory elements that increase fusion expression, and partial QKI loss. These mechanisms were investigated in primary angiocentric glioma specimens and experimental systems.

report_comment.text: MYB encodes a DNA-binding transcriptional regulator involved in hematopoiesis. QKI encodes an RNA-binding protein that regulates RNA processing and myelination. The rearrangement promotes MYB activity through truncation of MYB, relocation of regulatory elements that increase fusion expression, and partial QKI loss. These mechanisms were investigated in primary angiocentric glioma specimens and experimental systems.
